lead: A crate with the workspace's lints cannot free a `nvs_runtime::Value`, so a test in one leaks every string it builds.
body: `Value::release` is `unsafe`, `unsafe_code` is `forbid` at the workspace root, and `forbid` is the one level no `#[expect]` can lift. Split the decision from the allocation with a private enum holding the parsed scalar plus one `into_value` arm per variant, and assert the enum; `NvsStr` has a safe `Drop`, and `crates/nvs-db/src/pg.rs`'s `PgScalar` is the worked example.
